root: ^Long ago in the far reaches of the northern mountains rose a small village by the name of Günhildr. It was simply constructed so the miners would have shelter over their heads other than that of the cave’s ceiling.
^However on a cold winter day, deep into the caverns they found.. something.
^Where there had originally been mine now were corridors of cobblestone reaching ever deeper into the mountain.  It wasn't long before its allure brought the miners in crawling.
^At first, the ones who entered returned with glory and riches, yet seldom spoke of much else. All except one thing.
^The word that would quickly become its name.

^Rumors soon spread of its treasures  and the once forgotten town of Günhildr size and influence followed suit. Thousands flocked to the now bustling city in hopes of finding whatever they could within Agathol’s depths. Hoping they would become one of the lucky ones.
^Over 100 years have passed since those days. And my, how times have changed…

^I never got to see its prime. But I clearly witnessed its downfall. My son and husband did too but… they no longer share my breath. And my son… Of those who ventured into Agathol. He remains one of the ones who never returned.
^I can not live with the uncertainty of his fate…
^I need to know what happened to him.
